answer: Each identity commits a work history that unlocks in stages, violet first, full weight after 30 days. One upheld challenge across that span revokes the whole chain. Duplicates are caught on replay: a repeated payload hashes to an existing anchor and returns the old result instead of new credit. Names and labels are irrelevant; only the hash history counts. An attacker loses the island of accrued time on the first caught copy, and rebuilding it takes another month.
